method.detail: Published method identity; implementation uses the declared shared-protocol adaptations.

model.detail: Shared Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct, Qwen tokenizer, BGE-base-en-v1.5, seeds 42/123/2026; replaces original backbones.

tokenizer.detail: Shared Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct, Qwen tokenizer, BGE-base-en-v1.5, seeds 42/123/2026; replaces original backbones.

temperature.detail: per_qa_rag generation_params: do_sample false, temperature 0.0, max_tokens 1024; live module.py planner configuration also uses temperature 0.0/max_tokens 1024.

answer_temperature.detail: per_qa_rag generation_params: do_sample false, temperature 0.0, max_tokens 1024; live module.py planner configuration also uses temperature 0.0/max_tokens 1024.

max_tokens.detail: per_qa_rag generation_params: do_sample false, temperature 0.0, max_tokens 1024; live module.py planner configuration also uses temperature 0.0/max_tokens 1024.

answer_max_tokens.detail: per_qa_rag generation_params: do_sample false, temperature 0.0, max_tokens 1024; live module.py planner configuration also uses temperature 0.0/max_tokens 1024.

retriever.detail: BGE dense retrieval over the candidate passages supplied to every baseline; CoA reads all candidates without retrieval.

top_k.detail: Appendix D.1: executor retrieves five passages per subquery.

max_steps.detail: 256-step execution limit; method-specific step units are documented in agent_parameters.md. Reaching the limit returns an error.

seeds.detail: Shared Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct, Qwen tokenizer, BGE-base-en-v1.5, seeds 42/123/2026; replaces original backbones.

use_hyde.detail: per_qa_rag enables use_hyde and disables use_rewriter/use_relevant_expert.

hyde_query_repetitions.detail: PERQARAGExecutor.get_hyde_query repeats the original query five times before appending the generated first line.

encoder.detail: Shared Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct, Qwen tokenizer, BGE-base-en-v1.5, seeds 42/123/2026; replaces original backbones.
